summary: Carry current B12X master into beta: validated kernel cache, concurrent Engram reads, compact IQ2_XXS and Q8_0
compatibility: No user action required. Cached MoE routing selections are invalidated once, so the first start after updating tunes again.
details: Cached CuTe kernels are reused only after their size and SHA-256 match; a corrupt or incomplete cache entry is recompiled instead of failing startup (#418).
Disk Engram rows for several tables are read concurrently.
Compact IQ2_XXS and Q8_0 blocks stay resident for dense, GEMV, MoE and embedding kernels.
